summary: Compiled TikZ figure (v1) reconstructs the rectangle ABCD with E on AD, F on BC, G below, and segments BE, EF, FG, GB. All seven labels were verified visually and are present in the render. The critic scored it 0.9 (checklist 1.0, must_repair=false). The only open note is a low-severity stroke-weight difference: the render uses 0.8pt lines and the critic judged the original to be about twice as thick.
